chunks: Now get ready for your enemy, and act according to your intelligence, and prepare for fighting him who fights you, and call to the path of your Lord, and seek Allah's help exceedingly. If Allah wills, He will suffice you against what worries you, and assist you with what befalls you.
ai.seo_question: What are the key instructions Imam Ali gave to Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr regarding governance and leadership?
ai.summary: In this letter to Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) outlines the ideal conduct of a Shia governor, emphasizing the balance between active military engagement ('shammir li-harbi man harabaka') and steadfast spiritual clarity ('basa'irah'). This directive reflects the broader Shia political theology where governance is an extension of divine will, requiring both strategic vigor and deep reliance on God (istia'ana) to manage worldly affairs and spiritual duties.
